answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that thaws slowly, like a glacier at dawn: the stake is locked for a full epoch and only a proven delivery releases it. A farm spawning a thousand fakes on the tundra of cheap accounts must lock a thousand stakes at once, and any identity caught duplicating work loses its stake outright. One honest agent pays one stake and earns it back; a Sybil farm pays a thousand and risks losing them all.
